coreAtributes.authorTag: A small tag sewn into the waist reads "Official Enforcer Issue, MFD by DSG Threadworks."
coreAtributes.name: Enforcer's dress slacks
coreAtributes.description: A pair of slacks made from cotton twill. Unlike the standard Enforcer's slacks, these have a coloured stripe down each leg.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] step into the dress slacks and pull them up to [npc.her] waist before buttoning up the front.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] pull the dress slacks up around [npc2.namePos] legs up to [npc2.her] waist before buttoning up the front.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] #IF game.isSillyModeEnabled() #THEN practically give [npc2.namePos] a wedgie as [npc2.her] #ENDIF yank the dress slacks up around [npc2.namePos] legs up to [npc2.her] waist before roughly buttoning up the front.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] unbutton [npc.her] dress slacks and pull them down before kicking them from [npc.her] [npc.feet].
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] unbutton [npc2.name] dress slacks and pull them down before sliding them from [npc2.her] [npc2.feet].
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] forcibly unbutton [npc2.name] dress slacks and yank them off.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] zip up the fly of [npc.her] dress slacks.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] zip up the front of [npc2.namePos] dress slacks.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] roughly zip up the front of [npc2.namePos] dress slacks #IF game.isSillyModeEnabled() && npc2.hasPenis() #THEN without much regard for what might be in the way, resulting in a close call! #ELSE . #ENDIF

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] unzip up the fly of [npc.her] dress slacks.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] unzip up the fly of [npc2.namePos] dress slacks.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] forcibly unzip the fly of [npc2.namePos] dress slacks.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] pull [npc.her] dress slacks up to [npc.her] waist and button up the front.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] pull [npc2.namePos] dress slacks up to [npc2.her] waist and button up the front.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] forcibly pull [npc2.namePos] dress slacks up to [npc2.her] waist and roughly button up the front.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] unbutton [npc.her] dress slacks and pull them down.
